jobs.occupation: Offshore Shift Lead (m/f/d) for Nordlicht 79591 (Gruppen-, Teamleiter/in)
jobs.description: You want to aim high? At Vestas, you can! As the global leader in wind energy, we work every day to make the world more sustainable. With us, you will not only find meaningful work, but also many opportunities for personal and professional development. You can expect a varied job with responsibility in an environment that combines innovation and accountability. Take the next step and start your journey as an Offshore Shift Lead (m/f/d) for Nordlicht. The Vestas Service Offshore organisation is responsible for all activities in relation to the operation and maintenance of offshore windfarms in Northern and Central Europe. We currently have more than 4 GW under service contracts and we are continuously growing our pipeline and organisation.You will become part of an exciting journey taking care of one of the biggest OFS sites and the newest and biggest generation of Vestas offshore wind turbines, the V236.You will become part of the new SOV / CTV based team for the Nordlicht wind farm, consisting of 112x V-236 15 MW with a total capacity of >1,6GW, in the German North Sea. You will work in a key role of our Service team. Temporarily travel to other Offshore wind farms within Vestas for training, education and sharing experience is a vital part of the offered position.Your benefits – because your commitment counts! - Security & Perspective: Permanent employment contract with long-term prospects, plus a 14/14 rotation model for predictable assignments and genuine rest periods  - Development & Expertise: Comprehensive onboarding and regular training, including technical courses at the Vestas Academy and qualifications as an electrical specialist (DIN VDE 0105-100) if desired  - Working & Living Offshore: High-quality equipment, modern accommodation on an SOV with gym, cinema, and gaming zone, as well as full catering during your offshore shifts - Technology & Responsibility: Independent work with cutting-edge wind energy technology, innovative solutions, and space for your own ideas - Work-Life-Balance: 20 days of holiday during offshore deployment periods and 22 days of holiday during non-deployment periods - Add-On: Company bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, and the option for a sabbatical - Team & Culture: Open and respectful culture that values humanity and diversity, with a strong sense of community in an international environment Your responsibilities – here's where you can get involved!   - Lead day-to-day offshore operations directly from the Service Operation Vessel (SOV) on a 14/14 rotation schedule - Take ownership of team development through effective line management, coaching, and fostering a strong, collaborative culture - Ensure compliance and safety by reinforcing the code of conduct, promoting discipline, and driving HSE excellence through regular turbine inspections, safety walks, and audits - Facilitate technical focus meetings, team briefings, and support strategy deployment - Manage crew interface and contingency planning to ensure smooth SOV operations - Participate in toolbox talks and morning briefings, escalating HSE, performance, and operational issues when necessary - Oversee subcontractors activities onboard and ensure effective performance Your profile – what makes you a great fit! jobs.occupation: Offshore Stock Keeper (m/f/d) He Dreiht 78331 (Fachkraft - Lagerlogistik)
jobs.description: Do you want to play an active role in shaping the energy future? At Vestas, you can! As the global leader in wind energy, we drive innovation to create a more sustainable world. With us, you will take on responsibility, grow both professionally and personally, and work in an environment that encourages collaboration, courage, and fresh ideas. Would you like to contribute your expertise in an international environment? At Vestas, you’ll find exciting projects, modern ways of working, and real opportunities to make an impact. Take the next step and start your journey as an Offshore Stock Keeper (m/f/d) for He Dreiht.About the DepartmentThe Vestas Offshore Supply Chain Department is responsible for the logistic and warehouse operations on board of the Service Operations Vessels and Jack-Up Vessels. We are supporting the Vestas Offshore Special Projects and Service Departments which installs, services and maintains the wind turbines in multiple windfarms across the European seas.The department has an open and informal culture, where teamwork and good communication is the key to our success. You will have the opportunity to work in an exciting industry and in a team of highly motivated employees.Your benefits – because your contribution counts! - Security & Perspective: Permanent employment contract with long-term prospects, plus a 14/14 rotation model for predictable assignments and genuine rest periods  - Development & Expertise: Comprehensive onboarding and regular training, including technical courses at the Vestas Academy and qualifications as an electrical specialist (DIN VDE 0105-100) - Working & Living Offshore: High-quality equipment, modern accommodation on an SOV with gym, cinema, and gaming zone, as well as full catering during your offshore shifts - Technology & Responsibility: Independent work with cutting-edge wind energy technology, innovative solutions, and space for your own ideas - Work-Life-Balance: 20 days of holiday during offshore deployment periods and 22 days of holiday during non-deployment periods - Add-On: Company bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, and the option for a sabbatical - Team & Culture: Open and respectful culture that values humanity and diversity, with a strong sense of community in an international environment Your responsibilities – here's where you can get involved! - You are responsible for picking, issuing and receiving materials and spare parts for and from teams of technicians- You are in ongoing communication with the Service organization and technician teams to ensure the timely supply of necessary tools, spare parts and equipment- You are responsible for maintaining stock levels and inventory records in the SAP ERP system- You are ensuring accurate material postings and conducting regular inventories- You are ensuring order and cleanliness in the warehouse and work areas, while maintaining compliance with all health and safety requirements- You are coordinating the transport of goods and customs clearance during regular port calls- You are managing PPE, hoists, testing tools and other equipment requiring periodic inspections, testing or calibration- You are acting as the appointed person for calibration activities on site- You are requesting quotations for local purchases and initiating the creation of purchase orders- You are ensuring proper waste handling, disposal and offloading procedures on the vessel and in port- You are coordinating ad-hoc spare parts deliveries to the wind farm- You are supporting the Service Site Management team with a variety of organizational and administrative tasksYour profile – what makes you a great fit! - You have completed an apprenticeship and/or hold a degree in warehouse management, logistics, or a related field- You have experience working in a warehouse environment; experience within the wind industry is considered an advantage- You hold a valid driving license- You have experience with customs clearance and customs declarations, which is beneficial for this role- You are proficient in using SharePoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, TMS, and ERP systems such as SAP or Microsoft Dynamics AX- You have strong communication skills and are confident communicating in English- You have solid office and site management skills- You have strong time management and planning skills and can effectively prioritize multiple tasks- You are committed to adhering to and complying with all applicable local laws and regulations___________________________________________________________________________________________________________Über die AbteilungDie Abteilung Offshore Supply Chain von Vestas ist für die Logistik- und Lagerprozesse an Bord von Service Operation Vessels (SOVs) sowie Jack-Up-Vessels verantwortlich. Wir unterstützen die Offshore-Service- und Spezialprojektteams von Vestas bei der Installation, Wartung und Instandhaltung von Windenergieanlagen in verschiedenen Offshore-Windparks in europäischen Gewässern.In unserem Team erwartet dich eine offene und kollegiale Arbeitskultur, in der Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und eine klare Kommunikation die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs bilden. Du hast die Möglichkeit, in einer spannenden und zukunftsorientierten Branche zu arbeiten und Teil eines engagierten Teams zu werden, das die Energiewende aktiv mitgestaltet.Deine Vorteile – weil dein Einsatz zählt! -  Sicherheit & Perspektive: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit langfristiger Perspektive, sowie ein 14/14-Rotationsmodell für planbare Einsätze und echte Erholungsphasen - Weiterentwicklung & Know-how: Intensive Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Trainings sowie fachliche Schulungen an der Vestas Academy, inklusive Qualifikation zur Elektrofachkraft (DIN VDE 0105-100) - Arbeiten & Leben Offshore: Hochwertige Ausrüstung, eine moderne Unterkunft auf einem SOV mit Fitnessstudio, Kino und Gaming-Zone sowie Vollverpflegung während deiner Offshore-Schichten - Technologie & Verantwortung: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit modernster Windenergietechnologie, innovativen Lösungen und Raum für Ideen - Work-Life-Balance: 20 Urlaubstage während der Offshore-Einsatzzeiten und 22 Urlaubstage in einsatzfreien Zeiträumen sowie Option auf Sabbatical - Attraktive Extras: Business Bike, Fitnessstudio Zuschuss, betriebliche Altersvorsorge - Team & Kultur: Offene, respektvolle Kultur, in der Menschlichkeit und Vielfalt zählen und ein starkes Miteinander in einem internationalen Umfeld  Deine Aufgaben – hier packst du mit an! - Du bist für die Kommissionierung, Ausgabe und Annahme von Materialien und Ersatzteilen für bzw. von den Serviceteams verantwortlich- Du stehst in engem Austausch mit der Serviceorganisation und den Technikerteams, um die rechtzeitige Versorgung mit Werkzeugen, Ersatzteilen und Ausrüstung sicherzustellen- Du bist für die Pflege von Lagerbeständen und Bestandsdaten im SAP-ERP-System verantwortlich- Du stellst eine korrekte Materialbuchung sicher und führst regelmäßige Inventuren durch- Du sorgst für Ordnung und Sauberkeit in Lager- und Arbeitsbereichen und gewährleistest die Einhaltung aller Arbeitssicherheits- und Gesundheitsvorschriften- Du koordinierst den Warentransport sowie die Zollabwicklung im Rahmen regelmäßiger Hafenanläufe- Du verwaltest persönliche Schutzausrüstung (PSA), Hebezeuge, Prüfmittel sowie weitere Geräte, die regelmäßigen Prüfungen oder Kalibrierungen unterliegen- Du übernimmst die Rolle der verantwortlichen Person für Kalibrierungsaktivitäten am Standort- Du holst Angebote für lokale Beschaffungen ein und veranlasst die Erstellung von Bestellungen- Du stellst die ordnungsgemäße Abfallhandhabung und -entsorgung an Bord sowie die Entladung im Hafen sicher- Du koordinierst kurzfristige Ersatzteillieferungen zum Windpark- Du unterstützt das Service Site Management bei vielfältigen organisatorischen und administrativen AufgabenDein Profil – damit überzeugst du uns! - Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium im Bereich Lagerwirtschaft, Logistik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung- Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung im Lager- oder Logistikumfeld; Erfahrungen in der Windenergiebranche sind von Vorteil- Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein- Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung in der Zollabwicklung und Zolldeklaration mit- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit SharePoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, TMS sowie ERP-Systemen wie SAP oder Microsoft Dynamics AX- Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst dich sicher in englischer Sprache verständigen- Du besitzt gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten im Büro- und Standortmanagement- Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein gutes Zeit- und Planungsmanagement aus und kannst mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig erfolgreich priorisieren- Du handelst stets unter Einhaltung der geltenden gesetzlichen Vorgaben sowie relevanten Richtlinien und Vorschriften___________________________________________________________________________________________________________DEIB-ErklärungBei Vestas sind wir überzeugt, dass Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion entscheidend für Innovation und Erfolg sind. Wir heißen alle Menschen willkommen, unabhängig von Hintergrund, Identität oder Lebensweg – und ermutigen besonders diejenigen, die vielleicht zögern, sich zu bewerben.Wie unser CEO, Henrik Andersen, sagt: „Expertise und Talent kommen in vielen Formen. Ein vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld ermöglicht es uns, anders zu denken und die komplexen Herausforderungen unserer Branche zu meistern“.

Do you have solid experience working with change management? Are you versatile in communicating to different audiences while implementing new projects? Then we have the position for you! Vestas is looking for a Lean Specialist(m/f/d)!Service > Service Lean & Planning Excellence > OffshoreVestas' Global Service business was spun out as a separate business unit during 2014 due to the growing commercial and strategic significance of the service business. With our corporate strategy "Profitable Growth for Vestas" we have communicated specific, ambitious growth targets for service in coming three years. To achieve such targets while keeping our cost base steady requires a fundamental shift in how we operate - commercially as well as operationally.The Global Service LEAN team is responsible for driving further our Service Business' continuous improvement and execution excellence culture. We drive the process for Strategy Deployment, work on establishing global concepts, and execute breakthrough improvements based on world class methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma.ResponsibilitiesYou will be part of a team of Lean Specialists(m/f/d) in different geographical regions who will constantly work on increasing the Operational Excellence maturity of the Service business. While keeping high Safety and Quality standards, you will engage with employees, colleagues and stakeholders globally to implement our Service Lean roadmap.The tasks you'll perform in your region will include to:- Continue to develop and execute the Service Lean NCE Offshore roadmap- Secure Lean tools deployment, lead Kaizens and assess training needs- Reduce operational costs through the implementation of Operational Excellence Projects and concepts in alignment with Global Transformation Plans and Cost-out bridges- Facilitate sharing of Offshore best practices globallyQualifications- Academic Bachelor degree level or higher within Business Administration, Engineering or related field- Minimum 5-10 years of Change Management (Lean) experience and proven track record of success- Experience within the offshore working environment- Preferable experience as a manager- Either certification or certified experience or education in continuous improvement disciplines- Superior written/verbal presentation and communication skills in English, plus the main language in the country/region you work withCompetenciesOn the personal level it is very important that you possess influence and persuasiveness and have strong interpersonal skills. You have experience with change management/implementation. You must also have experience driving improvements based on value stream analysis and communicating the next steps towards future state in a way that our technicians understand. Moreover, we expect the following competencies:- Superior implementation and facilitation skills- Ability to create impact & connect with our workforce- Able to follow up in different countries (or areas within a country)What we offerWe offer an exciting job with great opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, hard-working, and international work environment in the renewable energy sector. We highly value initiative, responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will have good opportunities to build your career in Vestas, when demonstrating aspiration, capacity, and potential.Additional informationYour primary work location will be Aarhus, Denmark but could also be Copenhagen (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany), Oostende (Belgium), Arnhem (NL), Warrington (GB) or Szczecin (Poland).You should expect some travel activity, approximately 80 days per year. If the above match your skills and qualifications, please apply no later than 26.11.2026. Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. For additional information about the position, please contact: Recruiter Rebecka Thorell at rbthr@vestas.com (https://mailto:rbthr@vestas.com)
